tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Reported by The Guardian: Anthropic bans users from ‘needless abusive or cruel behavior’ towards Claude.
Reported by The Straits Times: Fired researchers accuse OpenAI of ‘chilling’ safety efforts.
Reported by BigGo Finance: MSI Launches $3,299 Prestige N16 Flip AI+ With Nvidia RTX Spark and 1-Petaflop AI Performance.
Reported by The Star: Nvidia-backed Upscale AI launches platform to connect chips from rival suppliers.
Confirmed, per RS Web Solutions: Nvidia and Microsoft have integrated a data center chip into a $2,599 laptop.
Free every hour.
